status: To be committed before any real-data E16 model fits or predictions; synthetic checks only so far
scope: Reuse E11 48 training-pool heldout cases and E12 five Ren allocations. ALL are now consulted development cases, including Ren. No fresh confirmation, subject-group validation, or new-domain claim.
outer_partition: Exact previous fit/query rows, costs, and Full/cost40 masks; excluded original outer-test rows unchanged. Outer query labels are never supplied to selection or fitting. Parent frozen record hashes checked.

inner_partition.groups: Exact duplicates of the full original feature vector within each outer fit set; not subject/document identity
inner_partition.algorithm: Random permutation of duplicate groups; greedily place group in least-populated fold, tie lowest fold index; seed202611160500+1000*family_index+100*outer_fold
inner_partition.sharing: Identical fold assignments for every learner and both feature masks
inner_partition.preprocessing: Min/max and geometry fitted on inner training only; constants zero; query outside range not clipped. Priors from inner training labels only.

G_and_U.constructor: Geometry-only bisection; no label-dispersion priority. G informative construction and query; U uniform both. 32+mean candidates each

RidgeProj.identity: New regularized linear baseline; not SA-BFGS

RKNN_pointwise.optimizer: Upstream full-batch SGD1e-3; kernel=True,sparse=True; no held-label stopping
RKNN_pointwise.gamma: Fixed from exact float32 training state; explicit pointwise adapter, not original query-batch gamma
RKNN_pointwise.budget_limit: Three declared anchors, not exhaustive tuning or independently crossed hyperparameters

selection.primary: Pooled inner Brier over all inner query rows, lower better. Candidate must be valid in all three folds. Within1e-12 choose smaller deployable numeric-array state then lexical candidate id. Explicit mean candidate allowed in all menus. No prior clipping or test-label selection.
selection.G_oneSE_secondary: Best-candidate pooled risk + sd(three fold means,ddof1)/sqrt3; cheapest outer numeric-state candidate within threshold, then risk/id. Heuristic only, not risk confidence bound.
selection.G_atU_secondary: Apply U-selected budget,query-k,prior-alpha to G, without G reselection. If U selects mean, both mean. Equal numeric-state capacity.
selection.RKNN_native_atSelected_secondary: Reuse selected pointwise checkpoint and parameters; change only query-batch gamma to upstream policy. Not separately tuned native RKNN.

failure_policy: Retain fit errors/warnings and incomplete candidates. Earlier valid checkpoints may survive later training failure. No silent renormalization. Outer failure remains missing, no substitute; comparisons must use common available cases and report counts.
outputs: Per case, seven selected policies per mask plus native_atSelected and fixed GG50/UU50 anchors per mask plus shared mean: 21 expected arrays. Freeze all outer predictions before scoring any outer outcome. Store inner predictions, choices, errors, explicit states and indices privately. Publish code/protocol and aggregate results/checksums only.
planned_analysis: Seven previous metrics; Brier primary. Summaries distinguish16 known families (average folds then macro families) and Ren single corpus five allocations. Report selected-mean counts, budget/k/alpha, byte/query-feature counts, failures, G_atU-U_min matched contrasts, and selected G-U descriptive contrasts. Preserve E11/E12 original fixed-primary results. No SOTA claim from restricted grid.
inference_storage_boundary: Numeric arrays needed for standalone prediction only; excludes Python objects, scalar metadata, execution workspace, selection training cost and hardware peak memory. Mean-only requires q float64 values and zero query features; no learned geometry attribution. Prototype full budget has K=n and unchanged count boundary.

upstream_code.status: Third-party toolkit, not verified original-author code
